decisions.label: Draw the contact sentence as a contact block
decisions.why: The page carries a sentence whose whole job is to say who to ask, set as body text at the top where it is read before anything it could answer. Drawn as the site's contact block at the foot it sits where a reader looks for it, and the banner gains the Contact chip that jumps to it. The sentence and its link are unchanged.
